title: Geometric Asymptotics of Score Mixing and Guidance in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models are routinely guided in practice by combining multiple score fields, yet the mathematical structure of score mixing is still poorly understood. We study the small-time generation dynamics driven by mixed scores $$ s=λ\,\nabla\log u_1+(1-λ)\,\nabla\log u_2,\qquad λ\ge 0, $$ in the heat-flow framework, where $u_1,u_2$ are heat evolutions of two compactly supported probability measures.
